newsitem.title: UK: Ogilvy & Mather names deputy managing director.
newsitem.headline: Ogilvy & Mather names deputy managing director.

text.p: Ogilvy & Mather, part of WPP Group Plc, on Tuesday said it hired Richard Pinder as deputy managing director.

Pinder, who has been client services director at Grey Advertising the last three years, joins the O&M management team of Tom Bury, who steps up from managing director to become chief executive officer and deputy chairman, and Mike Walsh, who remains chairman of O&M in London as well as CEO of O&M in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
O&M said the appointment was "a major development which signals the next generation of management".

"As my international role and responsibilities have grown I want to ensure a smooth evolution in the management succession in the UK," Walsh said in a statement. "Richard's arrival will enable me to hand over more of my responsibilities to Tom who, in turn, will hand over to Richard."
